summary: Interpreted the snapshot-repair receipt: the wedged node stayed at store 1..2 with certificate (4,2) and commit 2 before the phase, then after the leader's compaction-driven InstallSnapshot its store became 6..6, certificate (6,3) and commit 6 with the post-snapshot entry stored; the repair predicate holds and the repair set {restart, snapshot install} is now executed, while the wedge defect remains asserted.
